progress.command:
set -e
gh pr merge 87 --squash
git switch -q main && git pull -q
git log --oneline -1
git tag -a v2.5.3 -m v2.5.3
git push origin v2.5.3 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 20
id=$(gh run list --workflow release.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')
gh run watch $id --exit-status --interval 15 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo release ok || echo release failed $id
gh release list --limit 2
git ls-remote origin refs/tags/v2 refs/tags/v2.5.3^{}
